title: AgentRewardBench: Evaluating Automatic Evaluations of Web Agent Trajectories
authors_zh: Xing Han Lù、Amirhossein Kazemnejad、Nicholas Meade、Arkil Patel、Dongchan Shin、Alejandra Zambrano、Karolina Stańczak、Peter Shaw、Christopher J. Pal、Siva Reddy
paper_type_zh: 网页智能体轨迹评估基准与反馈审计数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究网页智能体评测、轨迹反馈契约、LLM-as-a-judge 与环境奖励审计的读者
one_line: AgentRewardBench releases 1,302 web-agent episodes with expert success, side-effect, optimality, and repetition labels plus 15 automatic-evaluator outputs per episode, but it supports offline audit rather than licensed deterministic replay.
AgentRewardBench 发布 1,302 条网页智能体完整轨迹、专家标签与每条轨迹 15 组自动评估输出，用于审计 LLM judge 和环境规则，但不提供已获许可的确定性环境重放。
why: It lets researchers measure false-positive and false-negative behavior in both LLM judges and task-specific rules before those signals are used to select agent trajectories or report success, while preserving failed examples and exposing release/replay risks.
inclusion_reason: AgentRewardBench exposes the otherwise hidden feedback layer of web-agent evaluation: full episodes, expert trajectory labels, official environment rewards, and multiple LLM judgments can be compared record by record, making it valuable for evaluation and failure audit while its licensing and replay gaps remain explicit.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The confirmed archival record is AgentRewardBench: Evaluating Automatic Evaluations of Web Agent Trajectories, published at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2025. This Card uses arXiv:2504.08942v2, the official project page, GitHub revision f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6, and Hugging Face revision b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61 as its evidence boundary.

The paper asks whether automatic evaluators can determine if a web agent actually completed a task. Task-specific rules are executable and cheap but can miss semantically valid success; expert review is richer but slow and expensive; LLM judges are more flexible but their false-positive and false-negative behavior was not well characterized. This is consequential because the same success signal may be used to report benchmark performance or select trajectories, even though the paper itself evaluates signals rather than training a policy or reward model.

The reusable evaluation surface contains 1,302 completed trajectories generated from 351 tasks in AssistantBench, VisualWebArena, WebArena, WorkArena, and WorkArena++ by four LLM backbones. A trajectory is a full episode: goal, ordered observations, agent reasoning and actions, URLs and accessibility-tree representations, screenshot references, errors, and episode summaries. The release connects each episode to expert labels, stored environment reward, screenshots, and outputs from automatic evaluators, so the feedback layer can be inspected record by record.

The paper and release are not identical descriptions of that object. The paper reports 3,906 binary annotations—success, side effect, and repetition for 1,302 trajectories—whereas the pinned annotations.csv has 1,408 rows for 1,302 unique trajectory keys, including 106 double-annotated keys and a fourth, four-level optimality field. The Hugging Face release contains 1,302 cleaned trajectory JSONs, 1,302 episode screenshot directories, and 15 evaluator outputs per trajectory. These version differences are part of the audit surface, not details to smooth over.

For environment_agent_trajectory_data, the paper is useful because it exposes observations, actions, environment-derived feedback, expert judgment, judge output, terminal labels, and replay metadata in one offline corpus. Its accepted curation_level remains L3_summary_ready and its status remains partial: licensing, upstream rights, deterministic replay, decontamination, privacy review, and annotation reconciliation are unresolved.

已确认的正式发表记录是 AgentRewardBench: Evaluating Automatic Evaluations of Web Agent Trajectories，发表于 Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2025。本卡片以 arXiv:2504.08942v2、官方项目页、GitHub revision f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6 和 Hugging Face revision b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61 为证据边界。

论文研究自动 evaluator 能否判断网页智能体是否真正完成任务。特定任务的 rule 可执行且成本低，却可能漏掉语义上有效的成功；专家复核更丰富，但速度慢、成本高；LLM judge 更灵活，其 false positive 与 false negative 行为却缺少系统刻画。这个问题会影响 benchmark 成绩报告和 trajectory 选择，因为两者都可能依赖同一成功信号；不过论文自身只评估这些信号，没有训练 policy 或 reward model。

可复用的评估表面包含 1,302 条已完成 trajectory，由四种 LLM backbone 在 AssistantBench、VisualWebArena、WebArena、WorkArena 与 WorkArena++ 的 351 个任务上生成。每条 trajectory 都是完整 episode，包括 goal、有序 observation、agent reasoning 与 action、URL、accessibility-tree 表示、screenshot 引用、error 和 episode summary。发布把每个 episode 与专家标签、存储的 environment reward、截图及自动 evaluator 输出连接起来，使反馈层可以逐记录审计。

论文与 release 对该对象的描述并不完全相同。论文报告 3,906 个 binary annotation，即 1,302 条轨迹各有 success、side effect 与 repetition 三个标签；固定版本的 annotations.csv 则有 1,408 行、对应 1,302 个唯一 trajectory key，其中 106 个 key 有双重标注，并额外包含一个四级 optimality 字段。Hugging Face release 包含 1,302 个 cleaned trajectory JSON、1,302 个 episode screenshot directory，以及每条轨迹 15 组 evaluator 输出。这些版本差异本身就是审计对象，不能被省略。

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，该论文把 observation、action、环境派生反馈、专家判断、judge 输出、terminal label 与 replay metadata 放入同一离线语料，因此具有明确价值。已接受的 curation_level 仍为 L3_summary_ready，status 仍为 partial：许可证、上游权利、确定性重放、去污染、隐私复核与标注差异调和都未解决。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The one-sentence contribution is: AgentRewardBench turns the feedback contract for web-agent evaluation into a benchmark object by pairing full episodes with expert reference labels, task-specific environment rewards, and multiple LLM-judge outputs.

Three layers are coupled. First, source agents execute benchmark goals through AgentLab and BrowserGym, producing trajectories with reasoning, browser actions, accessibility-tree observations, screenshots, errors, and summaries. Second, expert web-agent researchers review the completed episode. Their released record contains binary success, side-effect, and looping judgments, with raw Unsure values where applicable, plus four-level optimality: complete failure, suboptimal, somewhat optimal, or completely optimal. Third, automatic evaluators predict labels from different representations. The main paper compares 12 LLM-judge configurations and a functional rule reference; the release additionally includes two GPT-4o-mini input ablations, for 14 LLM configurations plus functional.

The reference contract is judgment-based, while the compared automatic signals are mixed. Expert success is a post-hoc semantic judgment of the completed sequence and is not an executable replay predicate. The functional evaluator converts stored cumulative environment reward greater than 0.5 into success and emits no side-effect, optimality, or looping labels. Simplified LLM judges receive the goal and action/reasoning history, optionally with the final screenshot and/or accessibility tree, then produce reasoning and four label fields. Model-generated judge reasoning is an evaluator artifact, not expert rationale.

The paper's central distinction is therefore not “human good, automation bad.” It measures which errors each feedback mechanism makes. Environment rules can reject trajectories that experts judge successful, while LLM judges can declare false success after trusting misleading reasoning, missing a task detail, misreading an action's intent, or failing to ground the episode in the browser state. Input representation also changes judge behavior; adding more modalities does not monotonically improve the reported results.

For reasoning-data curation, this makes evaluator output and disagreement part of the data object. A trajectory is not certified merely because it has an environment reward or an LLM judgment. The release supports evaluation and audit of feedback contracts; prospective discussion of RFT, RL, and reward models is not evidence of reward_modeling or agent-training use.

一句话贡献是：AgentRewardBench 把网页智能体评估的反馈契约变成 benchmark 对象，将完整 episode 与专家参考标签、特定任务的 environment reward 和多种 LLM judge 输出逐条配对。

该对象连接三个层次。第一，source agent 通过 AgentLab 与 BrowserGym 执行 benchmark goal，生成包含 reasoning、browser action、accessibility-tree observation、screenshot、error 和 summary 的 trajectory。第二，网页智能体专家复核完整 episode。发布记录含 binary success、side effect 与 looping 判断，适用时保留原始 Unsure，并包含四级 optimality：complete failure、suboptimal、somewhat optimal、completely optimal。第三，自动 evaluator 根据不同表示预测标签。论文主比较包括 12 种 LLM judge 配置与一个 functional rule 参照；release 另含两种 GPT-4o-mini 输入消融，因此共有 14 种 LLM 配置加 functional。

参考契约依赖专家判断，被比较的自动信号则属于 mixed contract。专家 success 是对完整 action sequence 的事后语义判断，并非可执行的 replay predicate。functional evaluator 将存储的累计 environment reward 大于 0.5 映射为 success，不输出 side effect、optimality 或 looping。简化 LLM judge 输入 goal 与 action/reasoning history，并可选加入最终 screenshot 和/或 accessibility tree，随后输出 reasoning 与四个标签字段。模型生成的 judge reasoning 是 evaluator artifact，不是专家 rationale。

因此论文的核心并非简单宣称“人工好、自动化差”，而是测量不同反馈机制各自会犯什么错误。environment rule 可能拒绝专家认定成功的 trajectory；LLM judge 则可能因相信误导性的 reasoning、漏读任务细节、误解 action intent，或没有把 episode 与 browser state 对齐而产生 false success。输入表示同样会改变 judge 行为；报告结果中，加入更多 modality 并不会单调提升表现。

对 reasoning-data 整理而言，这意味着 evaluator 输出与分歧本身属于数据对象。trajectory 不能仅凭 environment reward 或 LLM judgment 就被认证。该 release 支持反馈契约的 evaluation 与 audit；论文对 RFT、RL 和 reward model 的前瞻讨论不能证明存在 reward_modeling 或 agent-training 用途。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task sourcing and rollouts. The authors select 351 task IDs: 33 AssistantBench validation tasks, 100 VisualWebArena tasks, 100 WebArena tasks, 18 WorkArena tasks, and 100 WorkArena++ Level-2 tasks. WebArena and VisualWebArena are sampled across domain by original evaluation-method subgroups; WorkArena categories are approximately balanced. This is task sampling, not a decontamination procedure. The source models are gpt-4o-2024-11-20, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct, and Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct. The three multimodal agents run all 351 tasks; text-only Llama runs 251 non-VisualWebArena tasks, with two repeatedly timing-out WebArena tasks absent. The arithmetic is 351 × 3 + 251 - 2 = 1,302 released trajectories.

Agent environment and records. GenericAgent systems run through AgentLab and BrowserGym, which provide representation preprocessing, Gym-compatible environments, output parsing, and browser action execution. The paper reports a 40,000-token maximum input and 8,192-token output budget. Each cleaned JSON carries record-level agent, benchmark, experiment, goal, model and model arguments, package version, seed, flags, validity, ordered steps, and summary information. Steps can include URL, action, agent reasoning, accessibility-tree variants, screenshot path, open-page URLs, focused elements and bounding boxes, last-action error, and timing/token/cost statistics. These are offline serializations; no live website or database snapshot is embedded.

Expert annotation. Six web-agent experts use a custom Gradio interface that displays the goal, steps, reasoning, actions, and screenshots; they may inspect environments and accessibility trees. The paper says uncertainty and disagreements are discussed toward consensus and that the first half was annotated concurrently in person. Recruitment, compensation, per-task assignment, blindedness, and an immutable adjudication log are not disclosed. The paper reports a second success annotation for GPT-4o WebArena trajectories and 89.3% agreement. In the pinned CSV, there are eight distinct annotator identifiers, 1,408 rows for 1,302 unique keys, and 106 keys with two rows; the reason for the identifier and count differences is unknown. Under the released scoring convention that treats the first row as primary, the 1,302 keys contain 355 Successful, 946 Unsuccessful, and one Unsure success label.

Labels, splits, and evaluators. Expert records contain success, side effect, optimality, and looping. Only the first, second, and fourth are binary apart from raw Unsure; optimality has four ordered levels and one raw Unsure row. The task-level manifest divides 51 dev and 300 test tasks into 196 dev and 1,106 test trajectories. Hugging Face presents annotations as one full configuration, so users must join data/splits.csv and normalize .resized/.improved task IDs. Simplified LLM judges consume the goal, action/reasoning history, and optional final screenshot/accessibility tree; the pinned default evaluator settings are temperature 0.0, seed 0, and 1,024 maximum completion tokens. The functional reference thresholds cumulative reward at >0.5.

Release shape and use boundary. At Hugging Face revision b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61, filename inventory yields exactly 1,302 cleaned trajectory JSONs, 27,299 PNGs in 1,302 episode directories, and 19,530 judgment JSONs: 15 evaluator configurations times 1,302 trajectories. Every configuration has one file per trajectory by inventory, although response parsing and every screenshot reference were not exhaustively rerun. The release retains successful and unsuccessful completed episodes; persistent timeout attempts are not released. The demonstrated workflow is evaluator benchmarking and audit only, not reward-model or policy training.

任务来源与 rollout。 作者选择 351 个 task ID：33 个 AssistantBench validation task、100 个 VisualWebArena task、100 个 WebArena task、18 个 WorkArena task 和 100 个 WorkArena++ Level-2 task。WebArena 与 VisualWebArena 按 domain 和原始 evaluation-method subgroup 抽样，WorkArena category 大致平衡。这是任务抽样，不是去污染流程。source model 为 gpt-4o-2024-11-20、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct 和 Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct。三个 multimodal agent 运行全部 351 个任务；text-only Llama 运行 251 个非 VisualWebArena 任务，其中两个反复 timeout 的 WebArena 任务未纳入。发布轨迹数量由 351 × 3 + 251 - 2 = 1,302 得到。

智能体环境与记录。 GenericAgent 通过 AgentLab 与 BrowserGym 运行，后两者提供 representation preprocessing、Gym-compatible environment、output parsing 和 browser action execution。论文报告最大输入 40,000 token、最大输出 8,192 token。每个 cleaned JSON 在记录级保存 agent、benchmark、experiment、goal、model 与 model argument、package version、seed、flag、validity、有序 step 和 summary information。step 可包含 URL、action、agent reasoning、accessibility-tree variant、screenshot path、open-page URL、focused element 与 bounding box、last-action error，以及 timing/token/cost statistic。这些是离线序列化记录，并未嵌入 live website 或 database snapshot。

专家标注。 六位网页智能体专家使用自定义 Gradio interface，查看 goal、step、reasoning、action 和 screenshot，也可以检查 environment 与 accessibility tree。论文称不确定性和分歧会经讨论趋于共识，前一半数据由专家现场并行标注。论文未披露招募、报酬、逐任务分配、是否盲评或不可变 adjudication log。论文还称 GPT-4o WebArena trajectory 接受了第二次 success 标注，agreement 为 89.3%。固定版本 CSV 中却有八个不同 annotator identifier、1,408 行、1,302 个唯一 key，其中 106 个 key 有两行；identifier 与数量差异的原因 unknown。按照 release scoring code 将首行视为 primary 的约定，1,302 个 key 的 success 标签为 355 个 Successful、946 个 Unsuccessful 与 1 个 Unsure。

标签、划分与 evaluator。 专家记录包含 success、side effect、optimality 和 looping。除原始 Unsure 外，第一、第二与第四项为 binary；optimality 是四级有序标签，原始 CSV 另有一行 Unsure。task-level manifest 将 51 个 dev 与 300 个 test task 映射为 196 条 dev 和 1,106 条 test trajectory。Hugging Face 把 annotation 展示为单一 full configuration，因此用户必须连接 data/splits.csv，并规范化 .resized/.improved task ID。简化 LLM judge 输入 goal、action/reasoning history 和可选的最终 screenshot/accessibility tree；固定代码的默认 evaluator 设置为 temperature 0.0、seed 0、最大 completion 1,024 token。functional 参照以累计 reward >0.5 为阈值。

发布形态与用途边界。 在 Hugging Face revision b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61，文件名 inventory 恰好包含 1,302 个 cleaned trajectory JSON、位于 1,302 个 episode directory 中的 27,299 个 PNG，以及 19,530 个 judgment JSON，即 15 种 evaluator configuration 乘 1,302 条 trajectory。按 inventory，每种配置对每条轨迹都有一个文件，但并未穷举重跑 response parsing，也未验证每个 screenshot reference。release 保留成功和失败的已完成 episode；持续 timeout 的尝试没有发布。论文实际展示的用途仅为 evaluator benchmarking 与 audit，不是 reward-model 或 policy training。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The release-scale evidence agrees at the unique-trajectory level. The paper reports 1,302 trajectories across five benchmarks and four source LLMs. The pinned Hugging Face inventory contains 132 AssistantBench, 300 VisualWebArena, 398 WebArena, and 472 combined WorkArena/WorkArena++ cleaned JSONs, totaling 1,302. It also contains 1,302 screenshot directories and 15 judgment files per trajectory. These counts establish release shape, not correctness or training-data quality.

Against the expert success reference, no LLM judge in the main overall comparison exceeds 70% precision; the best reported overall value is 69.8% for GPT-4o(A). This is material for trajectory filtering because a high false-positive rate can admit failed episodes. The functional rule evaluator reaches 83.8% precision but only 55.9% recall, supporting the authors' claim that task-specific rules underreport semantically successful trajectories. High precision does not make the rule contract complete.

Input representation changes the simplified judge. With GPT-4o-mini, Table 2 reports success precision of 64.5% for screenshot only, 61.5% for accessibility tree only, 62.1% for both, and 60.7% for neither. The non-monotonic result is evidence that judge behavior is representation-sensitive; it does not prove that screenshots are generally superior or that any representation is sufficient.

The paper reports 89.3% inter-annotator success agreement on a second annotation of GPT-4o WebArena trajectories. Direct exact-match calculations from the pinned CSV produce nearby but not identical values depending on subset and Unsure handling, and no frozen script invocation or agreement output reproduces 89.3% exactly. No paper-level exact agreement is reported for the four-level optimality label. Consensus discussion may improve consistency, but the release does not preserve a complete independent-disagreement and adjudication history.

The qualitative error analysis identifies grounding mismatch, misleading agent reasoning, missed instruction details, and misunderstood action intent as sources of false-success judgments. Side-effect positives are rare, making precision low and conclusions unstable for that field. These are direct limitations of the feedback signals. They should not be collapsed into a single leaderboard number.

The strongest evidence-based conclusion is that AgentRewardBench enables record-level comparison among expert labels, environment rules, and LLM judgments while preserving both successful and failed completed episodes. The paper demonstrates evaluator evaluation. It does not demonstrate that these trajectories improve a reward model or policy, that the expert labels are error-free, that environment replay is deterministic, or that benchmark performance certifies data quality.

release scale 的证据在唯一 trajectory 层面一致。论文报告 1,302 条轨迹，覆盖五个 benchmark 和四种 source LLM。固定 Hugging Face revision 的 inventory 包含 132 个 AssistantBench、300 个 VisualWebArena、398 个 WebArena 和 472 个合并计算的 WorkArena/WorkArena++ cleaned JSON，总计 1,302 个；另有 1,302 个 screenshot directory，以及每条 trajectory 15 个 judgment file。这些数量证明发布形态，不证明正确性或训练数据质量。

以专家 success 为参考，主表整体比较中没有任何 LLM judge 的 precision 超过 70%；报告的最佳整体结果是 GPT-4o(A) 的 69.8%。这对 trajectory filtering 很重要，因为较高 false-positive rate 可能纳入失败 episode。functional rule evaluator 的 precision 为 83.8%，recall 却只有 55.9%，支持作者关于特定任务 rule 会低报语义成功轨迹的结论。高 precision 并不意味着 rule contract 完整。

输入表示会改变简化 judge。Table 2 中，GPT-4o-mini 的 success precision 分别为：仅 screenshot 64.5%、仅 accessibility tree 61.5%、两者同时使用 62.1%、两者都不用 60.7%。这种非单调结果说明 judge 对 representation 敏感；它不能证明 screenshot 普遍更优，也不能证明某种表示已足够。

论文报告 GPT-4o WebArena trajectory 第二次标注的 annotator 间 success agreement 为 89.3%。对固定 CSV 直接计算 exact match 时，结果会随 subset 和 Unsure 处理而变化，虽接近但不完全相同；release 也没有冻结的 script invocation 或 agreement output 可精确复现 89.3%。论文没有报告四级 optimality 的 exact agreement。共识讨论可能提高一致性，但 release 没有保留完整的独立分歧与 adjudication history。

定性错误分析指出，grounding mismatch、误导性的 agent reasoning、遗漏 instruction detail 与误解 action intent 都会导致 false-success judgment。side-effect positive 很少，使该字段的 precision 很低、结论不稳定。这些是反馈信号的直接局限，不能被压缩为单一 leaderboard 数字。

最强的证据边界是：AgentRewardBench 允许逐记录比较专家标签、environment rule 与 LLM judgment，并保留成功和失败的已完成 episode。论文证明的是 evaluator evaluation；它没有证明这些轨迹能改进 reward model 或 policy，没有证明专家标签无误，也没有证明 environment 可确定性重放，更不能用 benchmark 表现认证数据质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Before AgentRewardBench, web-agent evaluations commonly relied on benchmark-specific functional rules, while human review served as a costly fallback and LLM judging was a plausible but insufficiently audited alternative. The concrete change is to make the evaluators themselves the benchmark target. The same 1,302 full episodes are paired with expert references, rule outputs, and multiple LLM-judge outputs so precision, recall, disagreement, and failure modes can be compared on a shared record set.

The release adds unusual audit depth for this type of benchmark. It exposes cleaned trajectories, step-linked screenshot files, raw expert annotation rows, task-level splits, evaluator inputs and outputs, completion arguments, provider responses, parsed labels, costs, and source-trajectory metadata. Both successful and unsuccessful completed episodes remain available. The automatic-evaluator layer is therefore inspectable rather than represented only by aggregate scores.

This work does not introduce the five source benchmarks, AgentLab, BrowserGym, the four source model families, human trajectory review, environment rewards, or LLM-as-a-judge as general ideas. It also does not produce a trained reward model, an agent policy, a deterministic replay package, or a fully licensed training corpus. The four-level optimality field appears in prompts, release data, and scoring code, but its weak reconciliation with the paper's “3,906 binary annotations” is a release-version complication rather than a separate demonstrated contribution.

The direction signal for environment_agent_trajectory_data is that feedback provenance should travel with an episode. A terminal reward without its predicate, a judge label without its representation and model configuration, or a human label without an annotation protocol is insufficient for audit. AgentRewardBench demonstrates a useful multi-signal record, while also showing that disagreement and missing provenance are part of the data object.

Reuse should verify the pinned trajectory and annotation hashes, join the task split explicitly, preserve duplicate annotation rows and Unsure, distinguish expert from LLM-generated reasoning, pin all evaluator configurations, and retain both success and failure. It should also resolve licensing, upstream rights, environment versions, replay fixtures, decontamination, privacy, and annotation reconciliation before any training-oriented conversion. Scale and benchmark scores are not substitutes for these checks.

在 AgentRewardBench 之前，网页智能体评测通常依赖 benchmark-specific functional rule，human review 是成本较高的后备方案，LLM judging 则是合理但审计不足的替代方向。该工作的具体变化是把 evaluator 本身变成 benchmark target：同一批 1,302 条完整 episode 同时配对专家参考、rule 输出与多种 LLM judge 输出，从而在共享记录集合上比较 precision、recall、disagreement 与 failure mode。

该 release 为这类 benchmark 增加了少见的审计深度。它公开 cleaned trajectory、与 step 关联的 screenshot file、原始专家 annotation row、task-level split、evaluator input/output、completion argument、provider response、parsed label、cost 与 source-trajectory metadata，并保留成功和失败的已完成 episode。因此自动 evaluator 层可以直接检查，而不只表现为 aggregate score。

该工作没有发明五个 source benchmark、AgentLab、BrowserGym、四种 source model family、human trajectory review、environment reward 或一般意义上的 LLM-as-a-judge；也没有产出训练后的 reward model、agent policy、确定性 replay package 或已完整授权的 training corpus。四级 optimality 字段出现在 prompt、release data 与 scoring code 中，但它与论文“3,906 个 binary annotation”的调和不足属于 release-version 问题，不能当成另一项已证明贡献。

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，方向信号是反馈 provenance 应随 episode 一起发布。缺少 predicate 的 terminal reward、缺少 representation 与 model configuration 的 judge label，或缺少 annotation protocol 的 human label，都不足以支持审计。AgentRewardBench 展示了有用的 multi-signal record，同时也说明 disagreement 与 provenance 缺失本身就是数据对象的一部分。

复用时应核验固定版本的 trajectory 与 annotation hash，显式连接 task split，保留重复 annotation row 与 Unsure，区分专家判断和 LLM 生成 reasoning，固定全部 evaluator configuration，并同时保留 success 与 failure。在任何面向训练的转换前，还必须解决许可证、上游权利、环境版本、replay fixture、去污染、隐私与标注调和问题。规模和 benchmark score 不能替代这些检查。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The paper reports six experts, 3,906 binary annotations, and 89.3% success agreement, while the pinned CSV has eight annotator identifiers, 1,408 rows for 1,302 unique keys, 106 double-annotated keys, and a fourth ordinal optimality field. The mapping from raw rows through discussion/adjudication to the reported statistics is unknown.
  • The annotation protocol does not disclose recruitment, compensation, per-task assignment, blindedness, independent-label retention, or an immutable adjudication log. Optimality has no reported paper-level agreement statistic, and one raw row is Unsure.
  • The functional evaluator's >0.5 cumulative-reward threshold is an environment proxy, not semantic proof of success. Its 55.9% recall shows substantial false negatives against the expert reference. LLM judges remain vulnerable to grounding, instruction-detail, reasoning-trust, and action-intent errors; side-effect positives are too rare for stable conclusions.
  • Hugging Face file inventory confirms 1,302 cleaned JSONs, 1,302 screenshot directories, and 15 judgment files per episode. It does not prove that every serialized screenshot path resolves or that every provider response parses successfully. Those exhaustive validation reports are missing.
  • The task-level dev/test manifest must be joined manually because the Hugging Face viewer exposes annotations as one full configuration. No model-pretraining decontamination, public-task exposure analysis, or future contamination policy is reported. Public benchmark tasks are intentionally reused, and AssistantBench uses its public validation set because the test set is private.
  • Offline inspection is supported, but deterministic environment replay is not. Real websites drift; upstream benchmark, AgentLab, and BrowserGym commits are not all pinned; database/site snapshots and containers are absent; browsergym is only lower-bounded in requirements; and the runner sets strict_reproducibility=False.
  • The GitHub repository has no detected code license. The dataset uses bespoke Hugging Face terms rather than a standard open-data license, conditions research use on applicable fair use and third-party terms, and requires derivatives to propagate the terms. Component-level rights for five benchmarks, websites, ServiceNow content, screenshots, and model outputs are not closed.
  • AssistantBench episodes and screenshots observe real websites and may contain third-party content. The release provides no PII, privacy, or consent audit. This is a missing review, not evidence that personal information is present.
  • Official setup documentation includes a credential-like default example and endpoint templates. This Card intentionally does not reproduce any value. Reusers should remove or rotate defaults and keep credentials out of derived datasets, logs, and documentation.
  • Source-agent settings are only partly reconstructable: record-level model arguments, flags, seed, package version, and statistics are available, but a frozen Claude endpoint, all provider behaviors, environment snapshots, and aggregate decoding settings are not. Two persistent timeout attempts are absent, so failed pre-completion attempts are not fully retained.
  • The paper evaluates automatic evaluators. It reports no SFT, preference learning, reward-model training, process supervision, RLVR, or agent-policy training experiment with the release. Benchmark results cannot establish that the trajectories or labels are suitable training data.

• 论文报告六位专家、3,906 个 binary annotation 和 89.3% success agreement；固定 CSV 却有八个 annotator identifier、1,408 行、1,302 个唯一 key、106 个双标 key，以及第四个 ordinal optimality 字段。从原始行经讨论/adjudication 到报告统计的映射 unknown。
  • annotation protocol 没有披露招募、报酬、逐任务分配、是否盲评、独立标签保留方式或不可变 adjudication log。论文没有报告 optimality 的 agreement statistic，原始数据中还有一行 Unsure。
  • functional evaluator 的累计 reward >0.5 阈值是 environment proxy，不是语义成功证明。相对专家参考，其 recall 只有 55.9%，存在大量 false negative。LLM judge 仍会受到 grounding、instruction detail、过度相信 reasoning 与 action intent 误判影响；side-effect positive 又过少，难以形成稳定结论。
  • Hugging Face 文件 inventory 确认 1,302 个 cleaned JSON、1,302 个 screenshot directory 与每个 episode 15 个 judgment file，但不能证明每个序列化 screenshot path 都可解析，也不能证明每个 provider response 都成功 parse。相应的穷举验证报告缺失。
  • task-level dev/test manifest 必须手工连接，因为 Hugging Face viewer 将 annotation 暴露为单一 full configuration。论文没有报告 model-pretraining 去污染、public-task exposure 分析或未来污染政策。公开 benchmark task 被有意复用；AssistantBench 因 test set 私有而使用公开 validation set。
  • release 支持离线检查，却不能确定性重放 environment。真实网站会漂移；上游 benchmark、AgentLab 与 BrowserGym commit 并未全部固定；database/site snapshot 与 container 缺失；requirements 只给出 browsergym 下界；runner 还设置 strict_reproducibility=False。
  • GitHub repository 没有检测到代码许可证。dataset 使用定制 Hugging Face terms，而不是标准 open-data license；research use 受适用 fair use 法律与第三方条款约束，derivative 还必须传递这些条款。五个 benchmark、website、ServiceNow content、screenshot 与 model output 的逐组件权利链没有闭合。
  • AssistantBench episode 与 screenshot 会观察真实网站，可能包含第三方内容。release 没有 PII、privacy 或 consent audit。这表示复核缺失，不表示已发现个人信息。
  • 官方 setup 文档包含 credential-like 默认示例与 endpoint template。本卡片有意不复述任何值。复用者应移除或轮换 default，并确保 credential 不进入衍生 dataset、log 或 documentation。
  • source-agent 设置只能部分重建：record-level model argument、flag、seed、package version 与 statistic 已发布，但冻结的 Claude endpoint、全部 provider behavior、environment snapshot 与 aggregate decoding setting 不完整。两个持续 timeout 的尝试没有发布，因此完成前失败尝试并未全部保留。
  • 论文评估的是自动 evaluator，没有报告使用该 release 进行 SFT、preference learning、reward-model training、process supervision、RLVR 或 agent-policy training 的实验。benchmark 结果不能证明 trajectory 或 label 适合作为训练数据。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, AgentRewardBench is best used as a version-pinned offline evaluation and audit corpus. Each episode can be connected to its benchmark task, source model, ordered browser observations/actions/reasoning, screenshot evidence, expert labels, stored environment reward, LLM-judge input and output, and task-level split. This supports analysis of where an environment predicate, expert judgment, or LLM judge disagrees about the same trajectory.

The corpus is particularly useful for feedback-contract calibration. Researchers can estimate false positives and false negatives against the expert success reference, compare functional and judgment-based signals by benchmark or source model, audit whether judges trust agent reasoning over observable browser state, and repeat screenshot/accessibility-tree ablations. The 106 double-annotated keys can support limited disagreement analysis if raw rows and Unsure are preserved, but the unreconciled 89.3% calculation and consensus procedure prevent treating them as a complete reliability study.

Because the release keeps 355 primary-row successes, 946 failures, and one unsure case, it supports failure-retention audits and outcome-stratified inspection rather than success-only curation. Judgment records also retain prompts/messages, completion arguments, provider responses, parsed labels, costs, and source-trajectory metadata. These fields can be used to build evaluator regression tests or representation-sensitivity studies, provided model-generated judge reasoning is not relabeled as expert explanation.

Replay tooling can use the offline observations, screenshots, seeds, flags, package versions, and summaries to reconstruct an inspection view. It should not claim historical browser-state replay without pinned upstream commits, database/site snapshots, containers, reset fixtures, and provider versions. A defensible evaluation package should pin arXiv v2, GitHub f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6, Hugging Face b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61, annotation and split hashes, evaluator configuration, and split-join logic.

The safe use boundary is evaluation and audit only. Converting these episodes or judgments into SFT, preference, reward-model, process-supervision, RLVR, or agent-training data would require a separate training protocol plus rights closure, decontamination, privacy review, annotation reconciliation, replay validation, and evidence that the selected feedback is fit for that purpose. The paper does not supply those results, and automatic-evaluator benchmark scores do not certify training-data quality.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，AgentRewardBench 最适合作为固定版本的离线 evaluation 与 audit 语料。每个 episode 都可连接到 benchmark task、source model、有序 browser observation/action/reasoning、screenshot evidence、专家标签、存储的 environment reward、LLM judge input/output 与 task-level split，因此可以分析 environment predicate、专家判断和 LLM judge 对同一 trajectory 的分歧位置。

该语料尤其适合 feedback-contract calibration。研究者可以相对专家 success 参考估计 false positive 与 false negative，按 benchmark 或 source model 比较 functional signal 与 judgment-based signal，审计 judge 是否相信 agent reasoning 而忽略可观察 browser state，并重复 screenshot/accessibility-tree ablation。若保留原始行与 Unsure，106 个 double-annotated key 可支持有限的分歧分析；但尚未调和的 89.3% 计算与共识流程使它们不足以构成完整 reliability study。

由于 release 在 primary-row 约定下保留 355 个 success、946 个 failure 与 1 个 unsure case，它支持 failure-retention audit 与按 outcome 分层检查，而不是 success-only curation。judgment record 还保存 prompt/message、completion argument、provider response、parsed label、cost 与 source-trajectory metadata。这些字段可用于建立 evaluator regression test 或 representation-sensitivity study，但不能把模型生成的 judge reasoning 重新标为专家 explanation。

replay tooling 可以利用离线 observation、screenshot、seed、flag、package version 与 summary 重建检查视图，却不能在缺少固定 upstream commit、database/site snapshot、container、reset fixture 与 provider version 时宣称历史 browser-state replay。可辩护的 evaluation package 应固定 arXiv v2、GitHub f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6、Hugging Face b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61、annotation 与 split hash、evaluator configuration 及 split-join logic。

安全用途边界是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。若要把这些 episode 或 judgment 转换为 SFT、preference、reward-model、process-supervision、RLVR 或 agent-training 数据，必须另行提供训练协议，并完成权利闭合、去污染、隐私复核、标注调和、replay 验证，以及证明所选反馈适合该用途的证据。论文没有给出这些结果，自动 evaluator 的 benchmark score 也不能认证训练数据质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the publication and artifact pins together: COLM 2025; arXiv:2504.08942v2; GitHub f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6; Hugging Face b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61.
  • Separate the 1,302 unique episodes from the 1,408 annotation rows. There are 106 double-annotated keys; the paper's 3,906 binary-label count excludes the released four-level optimality field.
  • Read all three feedback sources independently: expert labels are the reference, functional thresholds stored reward at >0.5, and LLM judges predict labels from configurable trajectory representations.
  • Treat 89.3% reported success agreement as an author result that is not exactly reproduced by an obvious raw-CSV exact-match calculation; optimality agreement is unreported.
  • Use the 1,302 cleaned episodes, 1,302 screenshot directories, and 15 judgments per episode for evaluation and audit only. Licensing, upstream rights, deterministic replay, decontamination, privacy, and exhaustive linkage/parsing checks remain unresolved.

• 应同时固定发表与 artifact 版本：COLM 2025；arXiv:2504.08942v2；GitHub f838338886d723d40b586309465a38277803d9e6；Hugging Face b6d17e646009d6cb63d5dd7be78807b680693f61。
  • 必须区分 1,302 个唯一 episode 与 1,408 行 annotation。106 个 key 有双重标注；论文的 3,906 个 binary-label 计数没有包括 release 中的四级 optimality 字段。
  • 应分别阅读三类反馈：专家标签是参考；functional 以存储 reward >0.5 为阈值；LLM judge 则根据可配置的 trajectory representation 预测标签。
  • 89.3% success agreement 应视为作者报告结果；直接对 raw CSV 做显然的 exact-match 计算不能精确复现该值，optimality agreement 也未报告。
  • 1,302 个 cleaned episode、1,302 个 screenshot directory 与每个 episode 15 个 judgment 只应用于 evaluation 与 audit。许可证、上游权利、确定性 replay、去污染、隐私以及穷举 linkage/parsing check 仍未解决。
